seo.title: German B1 Course in Dehradun | Goethe-Zertifikat B1 | Language Zone
seo.description: German B1 (Intermediate) course in Dehradun. Give opinions, write emails, manage most situations. Online and offline batches at Language Zone.

outcomes: Deal with most situations while travelling, studying or working in German
Describe experiences, plans and opinions, and give reasons
Understand the main points of clear standard speech
Write letters and emails on familiar topics
Connect ideas in longer, flowing sentences
suits: Applicants whose work, training or residence papers often ask for B1 or higher
Professionals who need German in the workplace
syllabus: Subordinate clauses with obwohl, wenn, als and damit
Konjunktiv II for wishes and advice
Formal and informal emails, work and study vocabulary

skills.writing: Write emails and letters on familiar topics
skills.speaking: Present a topic and discuss it with a partner

faq.q: Why is B1 an important level?
faq.a: Many applications for training, work and residence in German-speaking countries ask for B1 or above. Always check the requirement of your own application.

faq.q: How much speaking will I do?
faq.a: Every class includes speaking tasks: discussions, short presentations and role plays.
Yes. Timed practice papers in the real exam format, with feedback on every part.
